notes: *the remnant* is italic and supplies a subject the Hebrew does not write, so it is added under rule 17; הָיָה keeps only *shall be*.
לַכֹּהֵן is read under rule 49's genitive clause: the article takes *the*, and לְ fuses with the noun in *priest's*. The copula is the written הָיָה's, so rule 49's copula sentence is not reached.
מִנְחָה heads on *offering* under rule 31's tie-break, since the ASV writes a bare *offering* for this word elsewhere; the competing head *meal* is recorded on the unit.
